# Prerequisites

Please have the following ready before class:

* R and R Studio installed on your laptop
* Have the INBRE_2026 folder shared by Chris Dunn downloaded on your laptop

# Learning objectives

At the end of this lesson, you will:

* Import a count matrix into RStudio
* Perform differential expression analysis and understand the results
* Create effective visualizations to interpret and present results
